p: thought can be withholden from thee: No thought so secret but you see it, nor anything that you think but that you can bring it to pass.
knowledge: Is there any but I? for this God laid to his charge, Job 38:2.
which I knew not: I confess in this my ignorance, and that I spoke of what I did not know.
and declare thou unto me: He shows that he will be God's scholar to learn of him.
heard of thee by the hearing: I knew you only before by hearsay, but now you have caused me to feel what you are to me, that I may resign myself over to you.
right: You took in hand an evil cause, in that you condemned him by his outward afflictions, and not comforted him with my mercies.
Job hath: Who had a good cause, but handled it evil.
pray for you: When you have reconciled yourselves to him for the faults that you have committed against him, he will pray for you, and I will hear him.
captivity of Job: He delivered him out of the affliction he was in.
brethren: That is, all his kindred, read Job 19:13.
fourteen thousand sheep: God made him twice as rich in cattle as he was before, and gave him as many children as he had taken from him.
Jemima: That is, of long life, or beautiful as the day.
Kezia: As pleasant as cassia or sweet spice.
Kerenhappuch: That is, the horn of beauty.
